settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.description: Playback setting title. Immediate D-pad jumps while controls are hidden; default Off.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.value: With controls hidden, Left/Right jumps by the skip interval. With controls visible, OK confirms. Off keeps reveal-first navigation.
settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.c.description: Explanation of optional D-pad seeking. Dedicated rewind and fast-forward work independently.

settings.playback.instant_dpad_seeking.o.description: Choice for the Instant D-pad seeking setting.
Choice for the Instant D-pad seeking setting.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.description: Playback setting title. Whether Dolby Vision is used when the TV supports it; default Auto.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.copy.value: Auto uses Dolby Vision when the TV supports it. Off plays the HDR10 layer instead. Files with no HDR10 layer are converted by your Plex server, and may not play.
settings.playback.dolby_vision.copy.description: Explanation of the Dolby Vision playback setting. Names the picker's two labels: settings.playback.auto and settings.playback.dolby_vision.off. Off can stop a file with no HDR10 layer (Dolby Vision Profile 5) from playing, because the server may refuse to convert it.

settings.playback.dolby_vision.off.description: Choice for the Dolby Vision setting (singular): Dolby Vision is never used.

settings.playback.resume_rewind.description: Playback setting title and picker title: how far before the saved spot a video starts when the viewer resumes it; default Off. Its options are Off (settings.playback.resume_rewind.off) and lengths in seconds (settings.playback.skip_interval.seconds).

settings.playback.resume_rewind.copy.value: When you resume a video, it starts this much earlier than where you stopped.
settings.playback.resume_rewind.copy.description: Explanation under the title of the Rewind on resume picker. Applies only when the viewer resumes (Resume, a Continue Watching card, a link that plays); starting from the beginning, the next episode starting by itself and the player's own reloads keep the exact position.

settings.playback.resume_rewind.off.description: Choice for the Rewind on resume setting (the default): a resumed video starts exactly where it stopped.
